insurer_name: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: PED 24 months (declared and accepted PED). Hypertension/Diabetes/Cardiac 90-day waiting unless disclosed as PED. Specific disease 24 months. Critical illness add-on 90-day waiting.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured plus Additional Sum Insured plus Super No Claim Bonus plus Sum Insured Protector

domiciliary_treatment.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured (over and above annual SI when opted)

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured for in-patient AYUSH hospitalisation

maternity_coverage.notes: Subject to product variant; not in indicative base coverage

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured for organ transplant donor expenses, subject to Rs.10 Lakh limit (over and above annual SI)

ambulance_cover.limit_text: 1% of Sum Insured, maximum Rs.10,000 per emergency hospitalisation event (road); Air ambulance up to Sum Insured (Extension 21)
ambulance_cover.notes: Domestic road ambulance + air ambulance (over and above SI)

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured for SI <=10L; 50% of SI for SI >10L; covers Cancer, CABG, Heart Attack, Major Organ/Bone Marrow Transplant, Permanent Paralysis, Kidney Failure, End-Stage Liver Disease
critical_illness_cover.notes: Optional rider — Extension 7; 90-day waiting; lump-sum payout over and above annual SI

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Unlimited Reset Benefit — refills sum insured unlimited times in a policy year
restoration_benefit.notes: Extension 22; total reset capped at annual SI per reset event

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Free health check-up coupon every Policy Year (max 2 coupons/year for floater policies)

room_rent_capping: No cap (subject to variant); single private AC room

disease_wise_sub_limits.cataract: Rs.20,000 per eye per Policy year for SI up to 5L; Rs.1,00,000 per eye for SI above 5L

worldwide_emergency_cover.limit_text: Worldwide hospitalisation up to limit specified, subject to 10% co-pay (over and above annual SI)

permanent_exclusions: Dental treatment unless due to accident
notable_exclusions_summary: 30-day initial waiting; 24-month PED waiting (declared and accepted); 90-day waiting on undisclosed hypertension/diabetes/cardiac. Cataract sub-limit Rs.20,000-Rs.1,00,000 per eye by SI band. Optional worldwide cover carries 10% co-pay. Standard IRDAI exclusions (cosmetic, infertility, refractive error, weight-control, hazardous sports) apply.
claim_process_summary: Cashless or reimbursement; over 6500+ network hospitals; Claim Service Guarantee.
